meta.name: triage
meta.description: Move issues and external PRs through a state machine of triage roles — categorise, verify, grill if needed, and write agent-ready briefs.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把问题和外部提交有序分流，生成现成的任务简报
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你维护活跃的仓库，每天要处理大量问题和外部贡献的改动。
copy.tagline_en: Triage issues and external PRs in order, producing ready-to-use task briefs.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain an active repository and deal with many issues and external contributions regularly.

howto.what: 当维护者用 /triage 提出要求时,Claude 会按状态机处理 issue 或外部 PR:先分类为 bug 或 enhancement,再验证、必要时追问,最后打上状态标签,并发布对应说明或给 AI 代理的简报。
howto.when: 当维护者输入 /triage 并说明需求时触发,比如查看需关注的内容、处理某个 #42、把议题移到 ready-for-agent 等。

say.text: 启动 /triage,显示需要我注意的 issue。
say.note: Claude 会按三个分桶列出待办项。

say.text: 看一下 #42,判断它是 bug 还是 enhancement。
say.note: Claude 会读取内容并给出分类推荐。

howto.what_en: On /triage, Claude moves an issue or external PR through a triage state machine: categorizes it, verifies claims, asks follow-ups if needed, applies a state label, and posts matching notes or an agent brief.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the maintainer types /triage and describes what they want, e.g. to review pending items, handle a specific #42, or move it to a state.

say_en.text: Run /triage and show issues that need my attention.
say_en.note: Claude lists pending items in the three buckets.

say_en.text: Look at #42 and tell me if it's a bug or an enhancement.
say_en.note: Claude reads the issue and recommends a category.
Claude applies the state and asks about writing a brief.
